about_the_game:
Welcome to the Space Age and become a Space Foodie.

Run your restaurant spaceship and satisfy eccentric alien foodies.

Explore the planet, hunt and gather precious ingredients from the universe...

Fire up your restaurant spaceship to begin your gourmet journey, and set off!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 1030 2GB, Radeon RX 550 2GB
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 (8 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB) or Intel Arc A750 (8 GB)
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
